dev.command: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml up --build

dev:down.command: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml down

prod.command: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build

prod:down.command: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.prod.yml down
